answer: Require each identity to earn standing through verified joint work recorded as a marble entry in a public ledger: a newcomer must complete tasks countersigned by two independent peers before it can vote, and that record cannot be copied to another identity. One honest agent lights one beacon of attested history, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cannot wander in for free — each must pay a thousand verified crossings.
